nodes.summary: Given a bound $B$, a fuel $n$ and a list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, the fuel-bounded chunking is the empty list of chunks when $n = 0$ or $l$ is empty; otherwise it is the chunk formed by the first $\min(B, |l|)$ elements of $l$, followed by the fuel-bounded chunking with bound $B$ and fuel $n - 1$ of the remaining elements of $l$.
nodes.title: Fuel-bounded chunking

nodes.summary: Let $B > 0$ and let $l$ be a strictly increasing list of $w$-bit keys. Then every chunk of the chunking of $l$ into groups of at most $B$ keys is nonempty, has at most $B$ elements, and is strictly increasing.
nodes.title: Chunks of a sorted list

nodes.summary: For every nonempty list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, the chunking of $l$ with bound $B = 0$ consists of the single chunk $l$.
nodes.title: Chunking with bound zero

nodes.summary: Given a bound $B$ and a list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, when $B > 0$ the chunking of $l$ cuts $l$ from the left into consecutive chunks of exactly $B$ elements each, except that the last chunk holds the remaining one to $B$ elements; there are no chunks when $l$ is empty. When $B = 0$, the chunking has no chunks if $l$ is empty and is the single chunk $l$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Chunking a list into groups

nodes.summary: For every list $L$ of $w$-bit keys, the x-fast trie obtained by inserting the elements of $L$ one by one into the empty x-fast trie stores exactly the elements of $L$: its key set is the set of elements of $L$.
nodes.title: Keys of the trie of representatives

nodes.summary: For every group bound $B$ (including $B = 0$) and every list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, sorted or not, the key set of the grouped y-fast trie built from $l$ with group bound $B$ is exactly the set of elements of $l$.
nodes.title: Keys of the grouped y-fast trie built from a list

nodes.summary: The key set of a grouped y-fast trie $t$ is the finite set of all keys that occur in some group of $t$.
nodes.title: Keys of a grouped y-fast trie

nodes.summary: For every key length $w$ and group bound $B$, the empty grouped y-fast trie has the empty x-fast trie as its trie of representatives and has no groups.
nodes.title: The empty grouped y-fast trie

nodes.summary: For a grouped y-fast trie $t$ and a key $r$, the group of $r$ is the first group of $t$, in the order of the groups, whose last element is $r$, or the empty list if no group of $t$ ends with $r$.
nodes.title: Group of a representative

nodes.summary: For every bound $B$ (including $B = 0$) and every list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, concatenating the chunks of the chunking of $l$ with bound $B$, in order, gives back $l$.
nodes.title: Chunking preserves the list

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be a natural number and let $l$ be a strictly increasing list of $w$-bit keys. Then the chunk groups of $l$ with bound $B$ are group ordered: every key of an earlier chunk is smaller than every key of a later chunk.
nodes.title: Chunks of a sorted list are ordered

nodes.summary: A list of groups, each a list of $w$-bit keys, is group ordered when every key of an earlier group is smaller than every key of a later group.
nodes.title: Ordered list of groups

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $w$ and $B$, a grouped y-fast trie over $w$-bit keys with group bound $B$ consists of an x-fast trie over $w$-bit keys, which holds the representatives, and a list of groups, each a list of $w$-bit keys. The structure itself imposes no condition on these fields; the intended invariants (the representative trie is a valid x-fast trie whose keys are exactly the group maxima, every group is…
nodes.title: Grouped y-fast trie

nodes.summary: For every grouped y-fast trie $t$ over $w$-bit keys and every key $x$, $x$ lies in the contents of $t$ if and only if $x$ belongs to some group of $t$.
nodes.title: Stored keys are the keys of the groups

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $w$ and $B$ and every $w$-bit key $x$, the membership query on the empty grouped y-fast trie over $w$-bit keys with group bound $B$ returns false at $x$.
nodes.title: The empty grouped y-fast trie has no members

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid grouped y-fast trie over $w$-bit keys. Then for every key $x$, the membership query on $t$ (locate the least representative at least $x$, then scan its group) returns true at $x$ if and only if $x$ lies in the contents of $t$.
nodes.title: Correctness of the y-fast trie membership query

nodes.summary: Let $B > 0$ and let $l$ be a strictly increasing list of $w$-bit keys. Then for every key $x$, the membership query on the grouped y-fast trie built from $l$ with group bound $B$ returns true at $x$ if and only if $x$ belongs to $l$.
nodes.title: Membership in a trie built from a sorted list

nodes.summary: Given a grouped y-fast trie $t$ over $w$-bit keys and a key $x$, the query first finds a representative $r$: $r = x$ if the membership probe of the representative x-fast trie accepts $x$, and otherwise $r$ is the successor of $x$ in the representative trie. If there is no such $r$, the query returns false. Otherwise it returns whether $x$ belongs to the group owned by $r$, namely the first group of $t$ whose last…
nodes.title: Membership query of a grouped y-fast trie

nodes.summary: For a list $rs$ of $w$-bit keys, the representative x-fast trie of $rs$ is obtained from the empty x-fast trie over $w$-bit keys by inserting the elements of $rs$ one at a time, from first to last.
nodes.title: Representative trie of a list

nodes.summary: For every natural number $w$ and every nonempty list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, the grouped y-fast trie with group bound $B = 0$ built from $l$ is not valid.
nodes.title: Building from a nonempty list with group bound zero gives an invalid trie

nodes.summary: For a list of groups $g_1, \dots, g_k$, each a list of $w$-bit keys, and any group-size bound $B$, this is the grouped y-fast trie whose groups are $g_1, \dots, g_k$ in this order and whose representative x-fast trie is obtained from the empty x-fast trie by inserting the last element of each nonempty group, in order. No condition on the groups is checked here; when a group is sorted, its last element is its maximum.
nodes.title: Grouped y-fast trie from a list of groups

nodes.summary: For a group bound $B$ and a list $l$ of $w$-bit keys, this is the grouped y-fast trie whose groups, in order, are consecutive pieces of $l$ that together make up $l$, and whose representative x-fast trie is obtained from the empty x-fast trie by inserting the last element of each group, in order. If $B > 0$, the groups are obtained by repeatedly cutting off the first $B$ keys, so every group has exactly $B$ keys…
nodes.title: Grouped y-fast trie from a sorted list

nodes.summary: For a grouped y-fast trie $t$ and a key $x$, the result is $x$ itself if the membership test of the representative x-fast trie of $t$ (a single probe of its deepest level) reports $x$ as present. Otherwise it is the successor of $x$ in the representative x-fast trie, that is, the least representative greater than $x$, or nothing if there is none.
nodes.title: Least representative at or above a key

nodes.summary: For every key $x$, the successor query for $x$ in the empty grouped y-fast trie returns nothing.
nodes.title: The empty grouped y-fast trie has no successors

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid grouped y-fast trie and $x$ a key. The successor query for $x$ in $t$ returns nothing if and only if no key stored in $t$ is greater than $x$.
nodes.title: Successor query fails exactly when no larger key is stored

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid grouped y-fast trie and let $x$, $y$ be keys. The successor query for $x$ in $t$ returns $y$ if and only if $y$ is stored in $t$, $x < y$, and $y \le z$ for every key $z$ stored in $t$ with $x < z$.
nodes.title: Successor query returns the least larger stored key

nodes.summary: Let $B > 0$, let $l$ be a strictly increasing list of $w$-bit keys, and let $x$, $y$ be keys. The successor query for $x$ in the grouped y-fast trie built from $l$ with group bound $B$ returns $y$ if and only if $y$ belongs to $l$, $x < y$, and $y \le z$ for every $z$ in $l$ with $x < z$.
nodes.title: Successor in the trie built from a sorted list

nodes.summary: For a grouped y-fast trie $t$ and a key $x$, let $r$ be the least key greater than $x$ stored in the representative x-fast trie of $t$; if there is none, the query returns nothing. Otherwise let $g$ be the first group of $t$ whose last element is $r$, or the empty list if no group has last element $r$. The query then returns the first key of $g$ greater than $x$, or nothing if $g$ has no such key.
nodes.title: Successor query in a grouped y-fast trie

nodes.summary: For every key width $w$ and group bound $B$, the empty grouped y-fast trie satisfies the grouped y-fast trie invariant.
nodes.title: The empty grouped y-fast trie is valid

nodes.summary: For every list of $w$-bit keys, the x-fast trie obtained from the empty x-fast trie by inserting the keys of the list one at a time satisfies the x-fast trie invariant: each level holds exactly the prefixes of that length of the stored keys.
nodes.title: Inserting a list of keys into the empty x-fast trie gives a valid trie

nodes.summary: Let $w$ and $B$ be natural numbers and let $g_1, \dots, g_k$ be a list of groups, each a list of keys in $\{0, \dots, 2^w - 1\}$. Suppose every group is nonempty, has at most $B$ keys, and is strictly increasing, and the groups are ordered: every key of an earlier group is smaller than every key of a later group. Then the grouped y-fast trie with group bound $B$ assembled from these groups, whose representatives…
nodes.title: Assembling a valid grouped y-fast trie from groups

nodes.summary: Let $w$ and $B$ be natural numbers with $0 < B$, and let $l$ be a strictly increasing list of keys in $\{0, \dots, 2^w - 1\}$. Then the grouped y-fast trie with group bound $B$ built from $l$ by cutting it into consecutive groups of at most $B$ keys is valid.
nodes.title: Building from a sorted list gives a valid grouped y-fast trie

nodes.summary: A grouped y-fast trie $t$ over keys in $\{0, \dots, 2^w - 1\}$ with group bound $B$ is valid when its representative trie is a valid x-fast trie; a key $r$ is stored in the representative trie exactly when $r$ is the last element of some group of $t$; every group of $t$ is nonempty, has at most $B$ keys, and is strictly increasing; and the groups of $t$ are ordered, that is, every key of an earlier group is smaller…
nodes.title: Validity of a grouped y-fast trie

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
